cohort: The study included 84 postpartum women aged 18-40 years in a tertiary care hospital.
finding: The prevalence of postpartum depression was 26.19%, and it was significantly associated with cesarean delivery, antenatal complications, and inadequate social support.
mod_finding: Depression was significantly higher among women who underwent cesarean section (36.84%) compared to those with vaginal delivery (17.39%).
